name: Cleanup After Ceiling Prime
intent: Tear down floor protection (spray methods only), pull wall edge masking (spray methods only), final inspect cured primer, clean tools. Each scenario stands alone in Phase 1 — protection and masking installed by ceiling prime are torn down at the end of ceiling prime.
doctrine: Final inspect ceiling at 1750 SF/hr is slower than wall final inspect (2000 SF/hr) because the inspector is craning the neck and primer telegraphs less under overhead lighting — meaning more time per square foot of inspection. Method-gated teardowns mean roll scenarios skip both teardown tasks (no protection installed for roll). Clean tools is fixed 20 minutes per session.
